blurb.text: A ward in the Coastal Region, in the district of Constantia at Cape Town, known for a sweet wine made from Muscat Blanc à Petits Grains. It was exported widely to Europe in the 18th and 19th centuries, stopped after phylloxera, and resumed at Klein Constantia in 1986.
